products.title: Columbia Men Blue Omni-Shield Silver Falls II Down Jacket
products.description: Don’t let cold weather keep you from hitting the trail, zip up the warmth and get out there in this warm, water-resistant jacket with 100% recycled insulation and rain-and-stain defying fabric. Omni-Shield™ repels moisture and resists stains by preventing liquids from absorbing into fast-drying yarns, so you stay clean and dry in damp, messy conditions 100% recycled polyester Thermarator™ insulation delivers lightweight warmth using down-like fibers that retain loft when wet, so you stay comfy i

products.title: Columbia Unisex Beige Omni-Shield Wildwood Heights 45L+5L Backpack
products.description: Wildwood Heights 45L+5L delivers an easygoing feel that adapts well to changing plans, making it a useful pick for unisex on the go. Thanks to its Polyester composition, it handles daily motion with ease and resists unnecessary wear. Versatile and uncomplicated, it remains a trustworthy option for regular use across seasons.

products.title: Columbia Unisex Blue Omni-Shield Triple Canyon 36L Backpack
products.description: Bigger trekking plans need more structure, and this 36L backpack brings side compression, 3L hydration compatibility and quick-access bottle pockets. Omni-Shield repellency, a rain cover, trekking pole attachments and a rescue-whistle sternum strap help support longer days outside.
